questions.sol:

Hence the value is \(f(g(0))=0\).

questions.sol:
Each toss succeeds with probability \(p=\dfrac{n-1}{n}\). Number of tosses is geometric with mean \(\dfrac1p=\dfrac{n}{n-1}\).

Mean: \(42+x+y=56\Rightarrow x+y=14\). Variance: \(\dfrac{460+x^2+y^2}{7}-64=16\Rightarrow x^2+y^2=100\).

The set is \(\{1,2,3,4,6,5\}\). \(P(\text{smaller}<4)=1-P(\text{both}\ge4)=1-\dfrac{\binom32}{\binom62}=1-\dfrac{3}{15}=\dfrac45\).

questions.sol:
Mean \(=\dfrac{\sum k(k-1)\binom nk}{2^n}=\dfrac{n(n-1)2^{n-2}}{2^n}=\dfrac{n(n-1)}{4}=60\Rightarrow n=16\).
The values increase with \(k\) and the frequencies \(\binom{16}{k}\) are symmetric about \(k=8\), so the median is \(8\cdot7=56\).
